test_name: Integrate OpenAI Model with Token Validation
description: This test ensures that a user can integrate an OpenAI model by providing a valid base URL and token, and verifying the integration.
steps: Navigate to the RoostGPT Config page.
Click the Gen AI Models tab to view integration options.
Type the OpenAI Base URL into the input field.
Type the OpenAI Token into the input field.
Click the Verify button to validate the integration.
Check that a success message is displayed confirming the integration.
expected_results: Integration is validated successfully with a success message.
Errors are displayed for invalid base URL or token.
edge_cases: User enters an invalid base URL format.
User enters an expired or revoked token.
User tries to verify without entering a base URL.
User tries to verify without entering a token.
Network timeout during the verification process.
data_requirements: Mock data to simulate invalid credentials.
Success and error response messages from the API.
dependencies: OpenAI Base URL and Token fields must be accessible.
Verify button must be enabled only when both fields are filled.
Backend API for token validation must be available.
performance_metrics: Load time for the Gen AI Models tab.
accessibility_requirements: Input fields must have ARIA labels.
Success and error messages must be screen-reader accessible.
Verify button must be usable via keyboard navigation.
